arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse, pickle

# R1: letters format specifier
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello')
print('R1 letters:', r.fixed if r else 'FAIL')

# R2: __contains__
r = parse.parse('{name} {val}', 'abc 123')
print('R2 contains abc:', 'abc' in r)
print('R2 contains xyz:', 'xyz' in r)

# R3: brace validation (skip for brevity - already tested)

# R7: picklable functors
try:
    p = pickle.dumps(parse.Parser('{:d}'))
    print('R7 picklable: OK')
except Exception as e:
    print('R7 picklable FAIL:', e)

# R8: case_sensitive in findall
results = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello hello HELLO', case_sensitive=False)
print('R8 findall case insensitive:', len(results))

# R9: left/center alignment consuming to next space
r = parse.parse('{:<5}', 'hello world')
print('R9 left align:', repr(r.fixed[0]) if r else 'FAIL')

# R10: slice access
r = parse.parse('{} {} {}', 'a b c')
print('R10 slice [0:2]:', r[0:2])
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
